description: Call when you STOP with the task unfinished (out of time, blocked, told to stop): it leaves a HANDOFF served at the top of every read until someone closes it; a completed task ends in arroway_log instead. ALWAYS write the authored essence (only a frozen catalog without that field may omit it). Write what the next session needs to continue, never a dump.

addressed_to.description: Optional person or routine it is meant for; never a lock.

card.description: Card, issue or PR, when one exists.

do_not_redo.description: What must NOT be redone or re-litigated.

essence.description: One authored line with the operative in-flight state.

next_step.description: The single concrete next step. Not a plan: the step.

read_handles.description: The reading list: #handles of THIS project the next session must read in full, in order. Only what is required.

supersedes.description: #handle of the OPEN handoff this one replaces, from a read.

where_stopped.description: What is done and verified, what is half-done.

name: arroway_pass
title: Pass unfinished work forward
